method: 5-word-shingle Jaccard similarity across each guide entry's full text (heading + introduction + whySeekAlternative + decision.fit), threshold <0.08, run pairwise across all 74 entries (44 pre-existing + 30 new this wave)
ruleFollowed: Never lower the threshold to make a failing pair pass -- rewrite the content until it is genuinely distinct.

collisionsFound.fix: Rewrote fathom-analytics's entire diagnosis/introduction/whySeekAlternative/decisions around a different, more specific real fact set (the credit-card-upfront trial auto-billing gotcha and the strict pageview step-ladder billing) rather than the shared 'no free tier' framing plausible's entry already used.

collisionsFound.rootCause: Both are notes apps sharing obsidian and notion as decision targets; first drafts used near-identical phrasing for the Obsidian decision ('notes stored as local Markdown files') and similar overall structure.
collisionsFound.fix: Rewrote microsoft-onenote's entire entry around a single, concrete technical fact -- the fixed 2GB-per-notebook ceiling that no paid Microsoft 365 tier raises -- with distinct sentence structure and vocabulary throughout, rather than mirroring evernote's local-first/repricing framing.
